title: Print Header Footer Navbar Spacing Parity
description: In the Zwischenbericht mit Bestand print report, the header (navbar) and footer chrome spacing no longer matches the on-screen app UI's navbar/footer spacing. The header currently has too little vertical spacing (too cramped) and the footer has way too much spacing (too much gap). Need to bring both back into parity with the app UI's navbar/footer padding, likely by adjusting headsep/footskip and/or internal chrome bar padding in print/tex/semio-window.sty (see SemioChromeNavbarHead, SemioChromeFooterHead, headsep=\semio@spacing@double, semio@chrome@footer@reserve computation around line 2621-2634).
summary:
Follow-up fix after the initial headheight correction: the footer's chip-to-border gap was still much larger than the navbar's, because both `\semio@chrome@navbar@bar` and `\semio@chrome@footer@bar` (print/tex/semio-window.sty) wrapped their chip row in a plain `\parbox[c][height][c]{...}` — centering the content within the declared navbar/footer height. Since the navbar's actual chip content (with its icon) happens to overflow its declared box height, it renders flush against the bottom rule "by accident," while the footer's actual content (logo images + author/page chips) is shorter than its declared box height, leaving deliberate centered whitespace on both sides — most visible as a gap between the rule and the chips. Verified this by rendering the real production document at mit-bestand/bericht/zwischenbericht/zwischenbericht.tex (with real `\footerauthors`/`\footerlogos` set) rather than only the generic print/ test fixtures, since the generic fixtures don't populate footer logos/authors and looked deceptively fine.

Fixed by replacing the vcentered `\parbox` in both macros with an explicit `\vbox to <bar-height>{...}` that pins the chip row a fixed `\semio@spacing@single` away from its own border (vfil above + fixed skip before the rule for the navbar; fixed skip after the rule + vfil below for the footer) — so the gap-to-border is deterministic and equal in both bars instead of accidental. Also removed a temporary `\typeout` debug instrumentation added during diagnosis (traced actual values: font/row height 6.57pt, navbar/footer height 1.8em=19.71pt, headheight 20.46pt, headsep 4.38pt, footskip 24.84pt — confirming a real ~5.9pt centering slack in the footer that wasn't present in the navbar).

Note for future sessions: `nx run ...:build` can silently serve a stale cached result even after editing a `.sty`/`.ts` input — this cost significant time misdiagnosing "my edit had no effect." Use `--skip-nx-cache` when iterating on print/tex changes.

Verified via `--skip-nx-cache` rebuilds of print/dist/{report,paper,flyer,forschungsbericht,zwischenbericht,kompaktbericht}.pdf and the real mit-bestand/bericht/zwischenbericht/dist/zwischenbericht.pdf, then rasterizing and pixel-measuring header/footer chip-to-rule gaps on both a scrreprt (\chapter) template and scrartcl templates — navbar and footer now sit flush against their border with matching ~0 gap in all cases. Rasterized before/after proof images and measurement scripts are kept in this ticket folder.
